name: WorkflowDuration
title: WorkflowDuration - Global
summary: The WorkflowDuration script include provides methods to calculates the duration (in seconds) based on the variables of a workflow activity. It is an interface between Workflow Timer() and DurationCalculator().

members.name: addSeconds
members.summary: Adds the number of seconds to the specified start date/time.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
record GlideRecord description
amount Number amount
Returns
Type Description
Boolean True, if object was successfully created.
